text:
marin: quick writeup from today's lightweight speculative-warmstart probe on ember-13b-quant. dropping numbers + an eval/playbook proposal.

felix: 'speculative-warmstart' = prefetch first tokens from smaller model? walk me through.

marin: yeah. run an ember-mini-3b quant as a warmstart to generate tokens 1..M, stream them immediately, then validate/complete with the 13B quant. goal: shrink TTFB for short replies.

tara: how do we detect a bad warmstart? when do we stop streaming and patch?

marin: we use a confirmation window: compare cheap->main topK distributions tokenwise. if sym-KL > 0.15 or token top-prob gap < 0.2 we mark token untrusted and trigger regen from that point. also keep a max-regens cap per request (2).

ops-bot: microbench (dev A100):
```
cheap (3b-quant) p50/token 9ms
main (13b-4bit) p50/token 24ms
warmstart M=5 -> client-first-byte p50 ~55ms vs baseline ~160ms
short-prompt end2end p95 down ~32%
```

cleo: interesting. metrics on output fidelity? auto + human?

marin: short-run eval on 400 mixed tasks: 
- EM-style extraction loss ~1.1% absolute
- embed cosine mean delta -0.009
- human A/B (60 pairs): warmstart preferred 22%, baseline 60%, neutral 18%
per-task: extraction and structured outputs show most failures; dialogue and creative mostly fine.

felix: so we see a measurable QoR hit in structured tasks. any mitigation tried?

marin: two quick knobs: (A) confidence gating (only stream tokens with softmax_top1 > 0.65 AND margin > 0.28) and (B) token-type filter (allow only whitespace/punct/function-word tokens by POS heuristics).

cleo: results?

marin: gating reduced human-pref drop: warmstart pref -> 28% -> 35% (i.e., less worse) but speedup drops. token-type filter very conservative: preserves quality but gives negligible latency wins.

ops-bot: config used locally:
```
--warmstart-m=5 --cheap-model=ember-mini-3b-4bit --confirm-symkl=0.15 --conf-min=0.65 --max-regens=2 --tok-filter=function_ws
```

tara: cost implications? running both models in parallel could jack infra cost.

marin: yep. cost math: per-short-session main-token tally dropped ~18% because many completions finish within M tokens; net cost per short session down ~8%. long sessions see +cost. routing matters: only enable on routes with median output < 50 tokens and high latency SLOs.

felix: operational stuff: what telemetry do we need to ship to Console?

marin: prefills_attempted, prefills_streamed, prefills_confirmed, regen_count, token_symkl_hist, route_level_success_rate. plus tracing spans warmstart/start, warmstart/confirm.

cleo: test plan to decide go/no-go?

marin: proposed evaluation plan:
1) curated 5k sample holdout stratified across QA, extract, summarize, code, chat. include 800 targeted "token-split" cases (names, compound tokens, hyphenation).
2) run 4 configs: aggressive (M=9, low conf), default (M=5, conf=0.65), conservative (M=3, conf=0.8), token-only (M=7 but token-type filter).
3) metrics: EM/ROUGE/BLEU, embed sim, human pref N=600 per cfg (focus on extract/summarize), regen rate, latency p50/p95, cost per session.
4) automated adversarial suite for tokenization splits and company-named entities.

tara: add an "auto-disable" rule: if route level human-pref delta > 5% or regen_rate > 12% for 24h, rollback to main only.

felix: also require a sandboxed A/B in prod with traffic cap 1% and automatic canary ramp if pass thresholds for 48h.

marin: runtime impl notes for eng-runtime: API flag warmstart: {model, m, conf_min, confirm_symkl} and ephemeral cache to hold prefill logits. need ability to stream warm tokens with a provisional flag so clients know tokens are tentative. add new trace attributes.

cleo: any weird failure modes seen?

marin: two we hit: (1) token-splitting across BPE boundaries -> cheap model sometimes merges tokens differently causing entity mangling, (2) length-bias: cheap model prefers shorter tail so combined generation sometimes truncated. we added a +0.03 length-bias correction when merging logits which helped but not perfect.

ops-bot: sample harness command:
```
python -m evals.warmstart_scan --cfg configs/warmstart/default.yaml --samples 400 --out results/ws_default.json
```

tara: next steps: marin to upload configs + adversarial set; cleo to schedule expanded runs; felix to spec telemetry & Console widgets. sync in 30m after initial expanded results land. :clock1: 

marin: will push branch with a README and the configs. ping when ready. thanks all :rocket:
